blocks.text: MANILA – President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. arrived in the Philippines on Friday after attending the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China, securing PHP41.1 billion worth of investment commitments expected to create more than 7,000 jobs.
